sources.title: Westville Hell's Kitchen reviews | Exa place listing
sources.text: So disappointing! Ordered a lemon drop martini to start, it came warm and it didn't have any natural lemon zest. OK, I moved on. Ordered the salmon with Greek lemon potatoes and asparagus with parmesan cheese. All sounded so good. The salmon piece was the size of my index finger and cooked well but very bland. The potatoes tasted like they had been sitting on a deli grill for hours, they just had this charcoal-like funky aftertaste, they were inedible.

itineraryNote: Westville Hell's Kitchen: a cheerful market-vegetable cafe on Ninth Avenue; order a Market Plate before the theater.
review1: Westville Hell's Kitchen is described as consistently good and relaxed enough for a long, easy conversation over a meal, making it a reliable neighborhood choice for a casual lunch or dinner.
review2: The chicken salad fritters are a cult favorite and the dish most often singled out as the thing to order at this location, making them an easy first order for anyone new to the restaurant.
review3: The bar team earns warm shout-outs, with bartenders singled out by name for making regulars feel at home, which adds a friendly neighborhood feel to evenings at the counter.
review4: Not every visit lands, with some accounts of a warm cocktail, small and bland salmon portions and side dishes that tasted stale, so results can vary from one meal to the next.
